headline: Sources: Tom Brady buys shares in Chelsea after Birmingham exit
description: Seven-time Super Bowl champion quarterback Tom Brady has invested in Chelsea soccer club, sources confirmed to ESPN and NFL Network.

headline: Man United CEO Berrada: Club 'heading in right direction' despite relegation form
description: Chief executive Omar Berrada insists Manchester United are "heading in the right direction" despite the club languishing in the Premier League relegation zone.

headline: Jack Grealish available for Everton against Brentford
description:
Jack Grealish is back in the Everton fold and could make his return in Monday's clash with Brentford.

headline: Xabi Alonso: João Pedro still not available, whole team needs to step up
description: Xabi Alonso said his Chelsea side need to learn to deal with the absence of João Pedro as the Blues struggle for goals in the absence of their injured striker.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal want Athletic's World Cup winner Nico Williams
description: Arsenal have reignited their interest in Athletic Club winger Nico Williams as they seek a new left-sided forward. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Aston Villa's Johan Manzambi available for Sunderland clash
description: Aston Villa will have Johan Manzambi available for the visit of Sunderland.
